image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a large common iguana resting on a branch. The iguana's head is tilted back with eyes closed, displaying detailed scale textures in shades of green, brown, and orange. A prominent dorsal crest runs along the neck and back. The background is dark and out of focus, highlighting the subject.

The visible portion of the torso appears thick and muscular, consistent with a robust body structure.
